summary: 1952 Aermotor LS-40 tower first erected as the Ila Tower in Madison County; moved to Walton County in 1973; privately owned; NHLR-registered 1997.

facts.design: 80-foot Aermotor LS-40 steel tower with 7 by 7 foot metal cab

access.note: Privately owned and on the Fairwoods Stewardship and Educational Forest; the sources give no visiting arrangement

notes_for_editor: Current status rests only on NHLR's present-tense 'located on' line; no source describes the tower's condition. Access marked private from the NHLR line that the tower is privately owned; no source read gives the owners' visiting policy. Staffing is not in any source. The brief's agency entry is the private owners, which NHLR names as administrators. The two Forest Lookouts pages agree with NHLR on the 1952 and 1973 history. A 100-foot 1952 line on the Georgia list sits under a different heading, so it is not used. Searches for the owners' own site found nothing usable. The brief's 218.5 m elevation matches NHLR's 717 ft.
